raw: {"analysis": "VTD provides a clear lane structure and explicitly handles sender-rules.json lock and irreversible registration, but its gate order runs the costly CI after sender ID registration, risking a failed build after an irreversible action. RXB improves on this by using enhanced mocks to validate timeout handling before the full CI, and includes a safety guard to prevent accidental registration, making it more cost-effective and safer. RXB also gives a concrete immediate next step, reducing ambiguity.", "verdict": "RXB"}
